relationships.subject: long-term meditation
relationships.evidence_quote: the temporal and spatial synchronizations of multispectral pain oscillations were substantially suppressed at primary and secondary somatosensory regions contra-lateral to pain stimulation

relationships.subject: pre-stimulus alpha activity
relationships.evidence_quote: the increase in pre-stimulus alpha activity predicted the suppressed synchronization of pain-related oscillations in experienced meditators

key_findings: Experienced meditators show suppressed early somatosensory pain-related oscillation synchronization outside meditation.
Increased pre-stimulus alpha at contralateral S1/S2 predicted the suppression, indicating proactive top-down inhibition.
